run_f_gold: run f_gold to count the number of set bits in an integer using Brian Kernighan algorithm
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple integer inputs to verify correct set bit counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python built-in bin method instead of bitwise operations
review_f_gold: review f_gold implementation of Brian Kernighan algorithm for counting set bits in an integer
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts set bits by repeatedly clearing the lowest set bit
